findings.evidence: `rg -n "\b(change|show|simpa|convert|revert)\b"` reports `386: rw [show ... = segRatio ... from ...]` and `439: rw [show (Complex.arg ...) = ((Complex.log ...).im : ℂ) by ...]`; the only `change` at line 493 has an explanatory comment.
findings.fix: Replace them with direct rewrites using the existing lemmas, e.g. rewrite by `← segRatio_eq_self_div ht.1 ht.2` and by `Complex.log_im`, or add a short comment explaining why the `show` cast is unavoidable.
findings.issue: Undocumented `show` rewrites at lines 386 and 439 are proof-quality smells: they depend on Lean accepting an exact displayed intermediate equality rather than recording the intended rewrite step.

summary: The proofs mostly use reasonable intermediate lemmas, but two undocumented `show` casts rely on goal-shape/definitional matching where a direct rewrite or named lemma would be more robust.
